note: Descriptive only: how raw count margins related to final certified margins in past cycles. It is not an input of any registered 2026 model or hypothesis. Margins are two-party D minus R in points; gap = raw count margin minus final certified margin at 10/25/50/75 % of the final two-party vote counted (positive = early count more Democratic, negative = more Republican). Cycles are 2020 and 2024 presidential only; n is the number of cycles.
